license_required.quote: The board shall issue a certificate of certified public accountant to any individual who complies with all of the following

issuing_authority.quote: The board shall issue a certificate of certified public accountant to any individual who complies with all of the following

age_minimum.quote: Is at least eighteen years of age.

moral_character_required.quote: Has not engaged in any conduct that would constitute grounds for revocation or suspension of a certificate or other disciplinary action pursuant to section 32-741.

degree_required.quote: successfully obtained a baccalaureate degree or higher degree from an accredited institution or a college or university that maintains standards comparable to those of an accredited institution

accrediting_body.quote: from an accredited institution or a college or university that maintains standards comparable to those of an accredited institution

required.quote: Have had at least two thousand hours of paid or unpaid experience, either before or after passing all sections of the uniform certified public accountant examination

duration.quote: at least two thousand hours of paid or unpaid experience

kind.value: experience in the practice of accounting
kind.quote: experience in the practice of accounting

exams.name: Uniform CPA Examination
exams.notes: Minimum 24 semester hours of nonduplicative accounting courses and 18 semester hours in related courses required to sit
exams.quote: A person shall not be permitted to take the uniform certified public accountant examination unless the person presents satisfactory evidence that the person has successfully obtained a baccalaureate degree

interval_years.quote: once every two years each of the following shall pay the registration fee pursuant to section 32-729 and register with the board as a firm

available.quote: If the applicant passes the uniform certified public accountant examination or the international qualification examination and has a certificate, registration or license to practice as a certified public accountant in another jurisdiction

requirements.value: Applicant must hold a certificate, registration or license from a substantially equivalent jurisdiction, or meet alternative education and experience requirements, or have been employed as a CPA for at least 10 of the 15 preceding years.
requirements.quote: The certificate, registration or license is issued by a jurisdiction whose requirements are determined by the board to be substantially equivalent to the requirements prescribed in subsection B of this section.

regulatory_model.quote: The board shall issue a certificate of certified public accountant to any individual who complies with all of the following

title_protection.quote: Uses the CPA designation in its firm name.

scope_protection.quote: Attest services or compilation services shall be provided only through a registered firm in good standing in this state.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Engaging in conduct that would constitute grounds for revocation or suspension of a certificate or other disciplinary action
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Has not engaged in any conduct that would constitute grounds for revocation or suspension of a certificate or other disciplinary action pursuant to section 32-741.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Failure to list all jurisdictions in which the firm has disciplinary actions in its application or registration
disciplinary_grounds.quote: A firm that applies or registers pursuant to this section shall list in its application or registration all jurisdictions in which the firm has any disciplinary actions

disciplinary_grounds.description: Failure to notify the board within one month of any change in owners resulting in less than a simple majority of CPA ownership
disciplinary_grounds.quote: an applicant for registration or a firm registered pursuant to this section shall notify the board in writing within one month of any change in owners that results in less than a simple majority of the ownership

definition_quote.value: experience in the practice of accounting, including balance sheets, income statements, cash flow statements or tax returns and the applicant's ability to communicate, either orally or in writing, on the results of an inquiry or analysis
definition_quote.quote: experience in the practice of accounting. The applicant's experience must be sufficient to demonstrate the applicant's ability for critical inquiry and analysis of financial accounting information, including balance sheets, income statements, cash flow statements or tax returns and the applicant's ability to communicate, either orally or in writing, on the results of an inquiry or analysis of that information to an employer, client or third party.

methods_authorized.quote: Attest services or compilation services shall be provided only through a registered firm in good standing in this state.

compilation_services_authorized.quote: Performs attest services or compilation services.

education_semester_hours_required.quote: the applicant has completed at least one hundred fifty semester hours of education

attest_services_require_firm_permit.quote: Attest services or compilation services shall be provided only through a registered firm in good standing in this state.

firm_majority_cpa_ownership_required.quote: Has a simple majority of the ownership, in terms of direct and indirect financial interests and voting rights, that belongs to holders in good standing of certificates or licenses as certified public accountants in any jurisdiction.

nonlicensee_firm_owners_permitted.quote: Has a simple majority of the ownership, in terms of direct and indirect financial interests and voting rights, that belongs to holders in good standing of certificates or licenses as certified public accountants in any jurisdiction.

peer_review_records_privileged.quote: Compliance with ethical investigations or practice monitoring programs conducted by the board or private professional organizations pursuant to programs preapproved by the board. These programs include, but are not limited to, quality and peer reviews. ... Disclosure of information under this paragraph shall not destroy its confidentiality and privilege

attest_report_signer_competency_requirem.quote: Any attest services or compilation services reports issued by a firm must be signed by a person who is certified pursuant to this chapter or qualified to exercise the limited reciprocity privilege pursuant to section 32-725, subsection G.

client_confidentiality_privilege.quote: Certified public accountants practicing in this state shall not be required to divulge, nor shall they voluntarily divulge, client records or information they have received by reason of the confidential nature of their employment.

foreign_accountant_practice_exception.quote: If an applicant passes the international uniform certified public accountant qualification examination of the American institute of certified public accountants, all of the following apply: 1. The applicant's country has a mutual recognition agreement with the national association of state boards of accountancy that has been adopted by the board.

firm_corrective_action_period_for_owners.quote: The board or the board's executive director may grant a reasonable period of time for the firm to take corrective action to maintain its qualifications as a firm.

firm_permit_required_for_attest_services.quote: Attest services or compilation services shall be provided only through a registered firm in good standing in this state.
